ATTAINABILITY.md offers three: score L3 on l3streamb alone and treat l3stream as the humility corpus it was built to be; add a skewed successor to the l3stream family; or read the gate per-corpus as a fraction of each corpus's attainable ceiling. The human decides; nothing frozen may be edited to force it.

decisions: STEP 0 first, before any engine code: wrote the state-composition arithmetic into README-l3 §0 and turned every cost claim into an assertion in trials/ops/l3/t_state_composition.py — R2's attainability-before-authority applied one level down, to the engine's own state.

CONFIRMED (a): L2-granularity indexing is impossible here. 21 index cells per event means 32/item, a 343-item capacity and 34 permille against a 90 permille gate; 900 items would cost 28800 units = 2.6x the whole cap. The remainder leaves 359/300 units of index per item, so the design is a SINGLE-POSTING handle index (1 cell/item): MinHash deleted, the other atoms deleted, discrimination moved to exact containment verification at query time, which costs state nothing.

CONFIRMED (b): per-eviction tombstones are impossible. One cell per eviction gives 12n + (10000-n) <= 11000, so n <= 90 items = 9 permille — a tenfold shortfall on the layer's own coverage gate. Designed an AGGREGATED forgetting record instead: per-t-range (evicted_count, evicted_mass) accumulators, 16 buckets coarsened by width-doubling, stated total cost 3 + 2*buckets <= 35 cells and 23 on the frozen streams — constant in the number of evictions.

CHOSE Letta S4 form B (true eviction now + recorded L4 co-design intent), with form A priced and refuted: 32h + 12c + 23 <= 11000 affords a full-granularity hot tier of at most 8 items at the bare gate and 0 at the occupancy form B actually reaches, because each hot item costs 1.67 cold ones. A two-budget design whose hot tier holds 8 of 10000 items is a decoration with a name. Recorded the intent that S4's demotion-into-consolidated-form is deferred to L4 because a cold tier is only affordable once L4 compression makes an entry cost less than the event it came from.

Composition, tight and asserted: 12n + record <= 11000 -> 914 items, occupancy 10991, unweighted-C 91 permille. Also asserted the cliff: at 13 units/item the capacity is 844 items and 84 permille — a red gate. The whole margin is 14 items.

Importance is structural and exact: grammar_weight x sum over uses of 1/(now+1-u) — ACT-R's optimized frequency-x-recency form, harmonic d=1, exact Fractions, float d=0.5 not reproduced. Only ordering and threshold bind; the eviction hot loop compares (numerator, denominator) pairs by integer cross-multiplication, so no Fraction is built per item and the ordering is identical to the rational one.

uses counts DISTINCT payloads, first occurrence only — and the rule holds at the door as well as afterwards. Fixing that (an arriving repetition inherits its cluster's standing but not its own arrival) was the one engine change the strains forced.

GATE CLEARED on l3streamb per R1: weighted-C 917, unweighted-C 91, F 1000, F_strict 190, B 1000, wrong 0, fabricated 0 — 1 permille off the 918 oracle ceiling, against baselines pinned at 100 and a capped engine at 34. l3stream scored as the ungated diagnostic: 174 against its own 190 ceiling, B 1000.

Strain (a): the attacked set survives WHOLE — 30/30 defended heavy items at flood sizes 50, 200 and 800, with the flood's footprint identical (31 slots) at every size and the cluster holding exactly ONE use however many copies are retained. The naive reference count, computed as a trial fixture and never as engine code, reaches 17x the weakest defended item's activation and would have swept the set.

Strain (b): murk at a 90-item cap (1399 of 1500 forgotten) — twins carry equal importance and are excluded from their cluster's uses (facts, not restatements), a repetition never evicts the fact it repeats (asserted as a forbidden outcome), wrong = 0 under full dirt, and contradiction pairs resolve EXACTLY by the field that differs where L2 could only abstain.

Strain (c): byte-identical snapshots across identical replays; a declared-safe permutation (adjacent, equal weight, distinct handles) leaves the retained payload multiset and the record's count and mass invariant; and moving an item across the stream lawfully changes what survives, asserted so the safe class is not vacuous.

Made the L4 humility seam a WITNESS rather than a promise: two streams differing only in the content of an evicted item produce byte-identical snapshots, so a forgotten payload leaves no trace in state at all and no injective map from the evicted set into 16 pairs of integers exists. Reconstruction from L3 state is impossible in principle, not merely hard — that is what humility/l4/IMPOSSIBILITY.md should be written against.
